touches.text: Trees as tables, temporary: made for one activity and dropped after it. Two kinds named so far: a working tree that sleep builds while consolidating and does not need afterwards, and config read from disk and held in the db. For config the file on disk stays the source: the tree is derived from it, rebuilt when the file changes, never edited in place.

Lifetimes. Each tree declares its lifetime when it is made: kept, one activity (eg one sleep run), or until its source file changes. Dropping a tree drops its leaves and its own links. A node goes only when no tree indexes it, so whatever a temporary tree's activity promoted into a permanent tree outlives it. The drop is enforced, not a habit: measured 2026-11-05, 61 test tables sit in the db, left by runs that ended without dropping them.

NOT HOW IT IS NOW (measured 2026-11-05; Akien: "I believe that it's not how it is now"): a node's id is a hash of its content (node_id_for, trees.py:126), not its row; the shared link list cairn_links has 0 rows; there are no per-tree link lists, no blob store, and no lifetime on any tree. Every node is embedded: the deposit door refuses a node without a vector (trees.py:250), and cairn_embeddings holds 21,880 embeddings for 21,082 nodes (798 point at no node). Walks derive their edges from vector proximity (nearest, neighbors); the stored-link door (trees.link) has written none.

Prebuild face: the chart chain, eight machines, each answering one question before a build begins: orient (what is asked, where does it live), constrain (what bounds it), survey (what already exists), decompose (how does it split), triage (what first, by what standard), hypothesize (what do we expect, how would we know we're wrong), validate (what does DONE mean, measured), and after the build, verdict (what done actually meant).

tree: the nexus graph-tree face (deposit, counsel, propose) over the librarian's trees. It is the same tool everywhere, not chart's: it is written as chart's only because chart was where it was first defined at that level. It stays a tool and does not fold into the librarian's verbs; a learning block holding its trees by the librarian's delegation (4.3.1.6) works them through it. A learning block that needs a special adaptation gets a subclass. (Q#54, Akien 2026-11-05)
